messages:
maria (People Ops): Idea: run a low-touch 'Thank-You Snack Stash' across SF/NY/LON on July 8. Small curated snack kits in-office + $10 e-gift for remote teammates. Add a 48-hour micro-shoutout window where folks nominate one colleague with a 1-line kudos. Low budget, quick delight. Thoughts?
andre (People Ops): Love it. July 8 avoids release dates. Budget cap?
sophie (Office Ops): I can get local packing teams. Recommend 3 volunteers per city for 2 hrs. Need lead time for labels and allergy stickers.
ravi (Benefits): Tax note: small non-cash items usually de minimis in US under $100; e-gifts may be taxable depending on region. I'll confirm US/UK specifics and post in thread.
maria (People Ops): Quick ops checklist: vendor shortlist by Fri 1) nomination form live for 48h starting Mon June 29 2) packing volunteers confirmed by Wed July 3 3) final RSVP locked July 6 4) send manager blurb. Please claim items.
andre (People Ops): I'll own vendors + budgets. :thumbsup:
sophie (Office Ops): I'll recruit volunteers and draft packing run sheet.
ravi (Benefits): Will post short tax blurb by Tue.
cheer-bot: Reminder set: create event "Snack Stash July" 2027-07-08.
maria (People Ops): Great, assigning owners: Andre=vendors, Sophie=logistics, Ravi=tax. If we hit milestones we go live July 8.
